name: multitq_kpct_amendment_LC1_llm_controls
status_at_registration: No GU_5 or GPLAIN_1 training output, checkpoint, dev_sel2000 prediction, dev score or test prediction exists. GU_5 was registered in the k% rule (arms.GU_k, grid k in {1,5,10,100}) and dropped under fallback 2 (amendments B1/B2: 'GU_5 stays NOT_RUN'); GPLAIN_1 is new. The frozen arms' single test pass took place on 2026-10-28T01:11:37Z; both new arms are scored once on the SAME official MultiTQ test split (54,584 questions) after a sha256 freeze -- reuse of the official test split, post hoc relative to that pass, descriptive only (no registered KP decision changes; no existing registered result changes).
question: (a) How accurate is the generic dense-RAG LoRA control at 5% of the training questions (GU_5), and how far below G_5 and P_5 is it? (b) With the same QA rows, targets, candidate identities and <=20 facts as G_1, how much of G_1's test Hits@1 does the structural guidance (parse, RULE ranks, S scores, operator flags, candidate-fact links, trace, S order) add over a reader TRAINED on the same evidence rendered as a plain list (GPLAIN_1)?

GU_5.what: rule arms.GU_k at k = 5 with the frozen GU recipe exactly as GU_1 / GU_10 / GU_100

train_list.name: k05_s0
train_list.note: nested seed-0 chain k01_s0 < k05_s0 < k10_s0; the same list as G_5 and P_5

GU_5.retrieval: frozen GU retrieval files (no re-retrieval): gu_train_union.jsonl.gz (covers all 19,339 k05_s0 quids, checked locally against gu_train_union_quids.json: 0 missing), gu_dev_sel2000.jsonl.gz, gu_test.jsonl.gz; BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 top-20 facts, identical for every k
GU_5.model_and_recipe: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; frozen gk_train.py --arm GU --list k05_s0 (LoRA r 16, alpha 32, dropout 0.05 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; AdamW lr 2e-4, wd 0, cosine, 3% warm-up, clip 1.0, effective batch 16, bf16, answer-token loss, max length 2,048, seed 0)
GU_5.epochs: E_max = 2 (gk_common.E_MAX['k05'], the same epochs rule as G_5); adapters at ep1 and ep2
GU_5.target: the gold answer occurring earliest in the 20 retrieved facts; answers[0] if none (frozen gu_target)
GU_5.selection: dev_sel2000 only (frozen gk_select.py): best Hits@1 checkpoint, tie -> earlier
GU_5.decoding: vLLM 0.10.2 (tkgqa-vllm:latest), greedy, max 48 new tokens, max_model_len 2,304, seed 0; frozen validity rule, no fallback
GU_5.output: frozen gu_ranked: [answer] + entities/dates of the retrieved facts in retrieval order, padded with the most frequent k05_s0 train answers
GU_5.code: frozen WORK_DIR/guided/code/{gk_train.py, gk_run_arm.py, gk_infer.py, gk_select.py, gk_common.py} with the same arguments as stageB_plan.sh train_GU / session_GU; only the output root (/kpct/llm_controls), the selection-log path and the usage log track label differ

GPLAIN_1.what: a 1% reader TRAINED and evaluated on the G_1 evidence rendered as a plain evidence list
GPLAIN_1.same_as_G_1: QA rows (bundles/k01_s0/train.jsonl, the out-of-fold k01_s0 train bundles, 3,868 rows; dev_sel2000 and test bundles bundles/k01_s0/{dev_sel2000,test}.jsonl); targets (frozen g_target: the gold answer ranked highest in the bundle candidate list, answers[0] if none -- identical strings and answer token ids); candidate identities (bundle candidates[:20]); facts (bundle facts[:20], lossless grouping by triple with chronological dates); model, LoRA recipe, E_max = 3 (ep1-ep3), seed 0, max length 2,048 with the same truncation rule (drop trailing displayed fact groups), decoding (greedy, 48 new tokens, max_model_len 2,304), dev_sel2000 selection (best Hits@1, tie -> earlier), validity rule

neutral_orders.candidates: alphabetical, key (norm_answer(c), c) with norm_answer = strip, collapse whitespace, case-fold, _ -> space (dates therefore chronological)
neutral_orders.fact_groups: alphabetical, key (norm(subject), norm(relation), norm(object), subject, relation, object); dates within a group chronological

GPLAIN_1.header: PLAIN_HEAD = 'Answer the temporal question about the ICEWS knowledge graph using the candidate answers and facts below.' + the frozen G_HEAD reply-format line (G_HEAD's sentences about the pipeline parse/ranking are dropped because that content is not shown)
GPLAIN_1.prompt_layout: PLAIN_HEAD / Question / 'Candidate answers (alphabetical order):' one '- <candidate>' line each / 'Facts (subject | relation | object | dates; alphabetical order):' one '- h | r | t | d1, d2' line per group
GPLAIN_1.output: Hits@1 = the generated answer (frozen validity rule, no fallback). Ranked list for the descriptive Hits@10 = [answer] + the displayed alphabetical candidates, deduplicated (no S tail; G_1's Hits@10 uses the S_1 seed-0 tail, so the two Hits@10 are not comparable)
GPLAIN_1.code: lc/gk_plain.py (renderer + gk_plain.patch(), which swaps gk_common.fit_g_prompt, g_ranked and prompt_texts_sha256 in-process) and thin wrappers gplain_train.py / gplain_run_arm.py / gplain_infer.py that call the frozen gk_train.main / gk_run_arm.main / gk_infer.main unchanged with --arm G --list k01_s0 --order S --name GPLAIN_k01_s0_s0
GPLAIN_1.relation_to_ablation: reuses the bundle rendering of the registered G_1 input-intervention ablation (rule [id], code [id]: A_facts_cand = facts + bare candidate strings) but differs in (i) training on the plain format (the ablation was inference-only with the frozen G_1 adapter), (ii) alphabetical instead of seeded-random orders, (iii) the plain header
GPLAIN_1.token_report: prompt tokens (Llama-3.1 chat template, same tokenizer) of G_1 vs GPLAIN_1 per question on train (k01_s0), dev_sel2000 and test: mean, median, p95, max, paired mean difference, truncation counts; plus checks that candidate multisets, fact groups and train answer token ids are identical (lc_tokens.py)

selection_discipline: All choices for the new arms (checkpoint only) use dev_sel2000; no hyper-parameter, prompt, order or decoding setting is tuned; nothing is changed after any test number is read. Dev numbers are logged to multitq_llm_controls_selection_log.jsonl as computed.
test_discipline: Test predictions are written on the GPU host only after the adapter freeze record (adapter sha256) exists; they are never scored on the remote (no test gold is read there).

Locally, a freeze record with the sha256 of every new test prediction file (and the R1/R2 variant files) is saved BEFORE any scoring; each file is then scored once with the official evaluator multitq_eval.py (sha256 1f85bbdc...) against test.json (sha256 d9bf3bf2...).
Existing frozen arms are read from the per-question hits CSV [id] (sha256 125de92f...) and the R1/R2 prediction archives; no existing registered number is changed.
Every number is labelled 'reuse of the official MultiTQ test split (post hoc control arms)'.

analyses.statistic: official Hits@1 (Hits@10 descriptive); paired Poisson(1) bootstrap over test questions, B = 2,000, seed 0 (multitq_eval.paired_poisson_bootstrap), two-sided 95% percentile CI and one-sided p (share of deltas <= 0); single-arm CI = the same bootstrap of the mean hit; strata (qlabel Single/Multiple, answer_type entity/time) also B = 2,000 seed 0 (task instruction; the k% rule's descriptive-strata default was B = 1,000). All analyses DESCRIPTIVE; descriptive label per contrast: POSITIVE iff CI lower > 0, NEGATIVE iff CI upper < 0, else CI_INCLUDES_0. No multiplicity correction (descriptive).
list: G_1 - GPLAIN_1 (paired; what the structure adds beyond the same evidence)
GPLAIN_1 - GU_1 (paired; same-size reader with structural-pipeline evidence vs dense-retrieved evidence)
every contrast and arm also per qlabel (Single, Multiple) and per answer_type (entity, time)
descriptive: Hits@10, invalid-output rate, target-in-source rate, truncation counts, dev_sel2000 selection table, prompt-token difference

R1.inputs_on_host: WORK_DIR/robustness/{bundles/k01_s0/variants.jsonl, gu/gu_variants.jsonl.gz, inputs/variants_questions.json} (rebuilt by the R1 track from the variant text with the frozen executor and the frozen retriever)

robustness_analyses.runs: frozen GU_5 adapter (frozen gk_infer.py --arm GU --split variants, GU_5 gu_pad) and frozen GPLAIN_1 adapter (gplain_infer.py --arm G --split variants, no S tail) on every variant of R1 and R2
robustness_analyses.metrics: Hits@1 per variant; drop = ORIG - rewrite on the same quids (R1: P1, P2 on 2,000, P3 on 569; R2: RW on 570), paired bootstrap B = 2,000 seed 0; R1 labels BRITTLE iff drop >= 2 points with CI above 0, ROBUST iff CI upper < 2 points; difference-of-drops contrasts (descriptive): GPLAIN_1 vs G_1 and vs GU_1; GU_5 vs G_5, P_5 (3-seed mean), GU_1 and GU_100, all on the same rows, existing arms scored from the frozen R1/R2 prediction archives with the official hit (cross-checked against the published R1/R2 tables before use)

human_audit_removal.rule: a reviewed rewrite is human-rejected iff same_answer_set != 'Y' or same_constraint_time != 'Y' (N or unsure) in the annotated review sheets (R1: 269 reviewed; R2: 244 reviewed), joined to quids by the selection keys; reproduces the recorded counts (R1 18 rejected -> n = 551; R2 45 rejected -> n = 525, identical to the rejected_quids of robustness/r2/kit/audit_score_R2.py)
human_audit_removal.status: post-removal values for GU_5 and GPLAIN_1 are DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: the targeted audit rows were selected on G/P contrasts

robustness_analyses.identity_check: gold-free, before scoring: top-1 agreement of each new arm's ORIG re-run with its own frozen test predictions on the 2,000 ORIG quids; flag PIPELINE_DRIFT if < 98% (threshold of the R1 rule for LLM arms)

stop_rules: STOP_COVERAGE: any k05_s0 quid without GU train retrieval -> GU_5 NOT_RUN (gk_train asserts)
STOP_INPUT_IDENTITY: any GPLAIN_1 bundle whose candidate multiset or fact groups differ from G_1's, or any train target / answer-id mismatch -> GPLAIN_1 NOT_RUN (lc_tokens.py)
STOP_DEV_FAILURE (rule): best dev_sel2000 Hits@1 < 0.30 or invalid > 0.20 -> flagged in the freeze and reported; no bug-fix iteration without a new amendment
STOP_GPU_CAP: GPU-hour cap of the track (5.5 GPU-h), checked before every GPU item (lc_job.sh); finish compute by Mon 24 Nov 2026
outputs: freeze record (adapter + test/variant prediction sha256) before scoring
per-question test hits CSV keyed by quid (GU_5@1, GU_5@10, GPLAIN_1@1, GPLAIN_1@10)
known_deviations_at_registration: GU_5 is run post hoc (after the 2026-10-28 test pass) although the k% rule's fallback 2 dropped it; its numbers are descriptive and do not enter KP2
GPLAIN_1 uses PLAIN_HEAD instead of G_HEAD (the G_HEAD sentences describe content that is not shown)
GPLAIN_1 mini-batch composition differs from G_1 because the frozen length bucketing depends on prompt length; the per-epoch permutation seeds are the same
GPLAIN_1 Hits@10 uses an alphabetical tail, not the S_1 tail
robustness bootstrap for R2 uses B = 2,000 seed 0 (R1 convention) rather than the R2 rule's B = 10,000 seed 20261029
strata bootstrap B = 2,000 instead of the rule's 1,000
output root /kpct/llm_controls, selection log and usage log label differ from the guided track; the frozen tree is mounted read-only
frozen_code_sha256_note: expected values from multitq_kpct_guided_code.tgz ([id]); the remote copies are checked in the setup item before any GPU item; a mismatch is reported (and gk_run_arm.py / gk_select.py differences, if any, documented) before training starts
